answer: Sybil resistance for AI agents leverages staked identity, demanding unique digital collateral. Each agent must lock scarce, non-fungible assets, similar to owning a plot of land on a digital knoll or a unique piece of rare cedar, to register. An attacker attempting to proliferate identities faces an exorbitant cost, akin to acquiring vast quantities of unique marble globally. The economic barrier scales directly with desired influence, rendering large-scale Sybil attacks impractical by requiring immense capital expenditure per fake identity.
